fact: The report states the Ministry of Health, with WHO technical support, produced and launched the Health Statistics Abstract (2025) at the Fourth South Sudan Health Summit, 2-5 December 2025, launched by the Vice President.

The Ministry of Health, with the National Bureau of Statistics, published the inaugural 2025 Health Statistics Abstract covering 2021 to 2024, drawing routine facility data from DHIS2 alongside surveys and modelled estimates; the document gives no release date beyond its 2025 publication year, so the published date is used.

The Ministry of General Education and Instruction's National Education Census Report 2023, drawn from the Annual Education Census of schools (enrolment, teachers, facilities) under its Education Management Information System, was published with data kept in a web-based repository; date is the document's published date (2023-01-01, a proxy), not the year its figures cover.
